[ACT](RC):[Put this unit into your soul] Choose your <Dimension Police> vanguard, and that unit gets [Power] +4000 until end of turn.
cards.flavor: Pierce through! Yusha Magnum!

cards.text:
[AUTO](VC)[Limit-Break 4](This ability is active if you have four or more damage):When this unit attacks a vanguard, this unit gets [Power] +5000 until end of that battle.
[AUTO]:[Counter-Blast 2] When this unit is placed on (VC), you may pay the cost. If you do, choose one of your opponent's rear-guards, and lock it. (The locked card is turned face down, and cannot do anything. It turns face up at end of the owner's turn.)
cards.flavor: Entropy will increase, if the world is enclosed.

cards.text: [AUTO](VC/RC):[Counter-Blast 2] When this unit's attack hits, if you have a &ltLink Joker&gt vanguard, you may pay the cost. If you do, draw a card.
cards.flavor: At first glance, this place seems like an eden…… except for the existence of that oddity.

cards.text:
[AUTO]:Forerunner (When a unit of the same clan rides this unit, you may call this unit to (RC))
[AUTO](RC):When your opponent's rear-guard is locked due to an effect from one of your cards, if you have a <Link Joker> vanguard, you may return this unit to your hand.
cards.flavor: The world has already changed. Yes, that was just the beginning.

cards.text:
[AUTO](VC):[Choose one of your grade 3 or greater <Granblue> rear-guards, and retire it] When this unit's drive check reveals a grade 3 <Granblue>, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a <Granblue> from your drop zone, and call it to an open (RC).
[CONT](VC):During your turn, if the number of <Granblue> rear-guards you have is four or more, this unit gets [Power] +3000.
cards.flavor: You're not always dead, get back to work you chappies!

cards.text: [AUTO]:[Soul-Blast 1] When this unit is placed on (RC) from your drop zone, if you have a &ltGranblue&gt vanguard, you may pay the cost. If you do, draw a card.
cards.flavor: Yes, it will be really bad if it rained.

cards.text: [AUTO](RC):At the end of the battle that this unit attacked a vanguard, if you have an &ltAqua Force&gt vanguard, [Stand] this unit, and this unit gets [Power] -5000 until end of turn. This ability cannot be used for the rest of that turn.
cards.flavor: Can you hear it? The thundering waves splashing repeatedly!

cards.text: [AUTO](RC):[Counter-Blast 1] At the end of the battle that this unit boosted([Boost]), if you have an &ltAqua Force&gt vanguard, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose two of your &ltAqua Force&gt rear-guards, and exchange their positions. (The state of the card does not change.)
cards.flavor: The environment changes. And to adapt to change is called progress.

cards.text:
[AUTO]:Forerunner (When a unit of the same clan rides this unit, you may call this unit to (RC))
[ACT](RC):[Put this unit into your soul] If you have an <Aqua Force> vanguard, choose one of your <Aqua Force>, and until end of turn, that unit gets "[AUTO](VC/RC):When this unit attacks a vanguard, if it is the fourth battle of that turn or more, draw a card.".
cards.flavor: Efficiency is very high when training in water. We shall become warriors of the great army!

cards.text: [AUTO](VC):When this unit's drive check reveals a grade 3 &ltGreat Nature&gt, choose two of your &ltGreat Nature&gt rear-guards, and you may have those units get [Power] +4000 until end of turn. If you do, at the end of that turn, retire those units.
cards.flavor: What, you call that a settlement?! Huh?

cards.text: [AUTO]:[Counter-Blast 1 & Choose three grade 1 or greater &ltGreat Nature&gt other than a card named "Wash Up Racoon" from your drop zone, and put them on the bottom of your deck in any order] During your end phase, when this unit is put into your drop zone from (RC), if you have a &ltGreat Nature&gt vanguard, you may pay the cost. If you do, search your deck for up to one card named "Wash Up Racoon", reveal it to your opponent, put it into your hand, and shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: Anyways, I think it's still better to wash up first.

cards.text: [AUTO](VC/RC):[Choose a card from your hand. and discard it] When this unit's attack hits, if you have an &ltAngel Feather&gt vanguard, you may pay the cost. If you do, draw a card.
cards.flavor: This is part of the service. Let's wrap you up.

cards.text: [CONT](VC/RC):During your turn, this unit gets [Power] +2000 for each card named "Operation Celestial, Armen" face up in your damage zone.
cards.flavor: Heh heh heh! Let's heal this up quickly!

cards.text: [ACT](VC/RC):[Counter-Blast 2] This unit gets [Power] +4000 until end of turn.
cards.flavor: We'll do it in one go!! Fire off all scalpels!

cards.text: [CONT](VC/RC):During your turn, this unit gets [Power] +2000 for each card named "Operation Celestial, Armen" face up in your damage zone.
cards.flavor: Relax. Just leave everything to us.

cards.text: [AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC), choose one of your other &ltAngel Feather&gt, and that unit gets [Power] +2000 until end of turn.
cards.flavor: A kind smile. That is what the Angel Feathers take pride in.

cards.text:
[AUTO]:Forerunner (When a unit of the same clan rides this unit, you may call this unit to (RC))
[AUTO](RC):[Counter-Blast 1 & Put this unit into your soul] At the beginning of your ride phase, if you have an <Angel Feather> vanguard, you may pay the cost. If you do, put the top card of your deck into your damage zone, and at the end of that turn, choose a card from your damage zone, return it to your deck, and shuffle your deck.
cards.flavor: An angel's smile does not only call forth tranquility.

cards.card_name: Stealth Rogue of a Thousand Blades, Oborozakura
cards.flavor: If you value your life, leave the blade and depart immediately.

cards.text: [AUTO](RC):During your turn, when your opponent's card is placed in his or her bind zone, if you have a &ltNubatama&gt vanguard, this unit gets [Power] +2000 until end of turn.
cards.flavor: Dance, purgatory flames! Stealth Arts, Blazing Dance!

cards.text: [AUTO](VC/RC):When this unit attacks, if you have a &ltNubatama&gt vanguard or rear-guard with [Limit-Break 4], this unit gets [Power] +3000 until end of that battle.
cards.flavor: They are the prison guards of Hades. We call them the Gosirsa.

cards.card_name: Stealth Rogue of the Night, Sakurafubuki
cards.flavor: With darkness as a friend, those who write history from behind the scenes, are known as the black shadows...... Nubatama.

cards.text: [ACT](RC):[Counter-Blast 1 & Put this unit into your soul] If you have a &ltNubatama&gt vanguard, and the number of cards in your opponent's hand is three or more, you may pay the cost. If you do, choose a card at random from your opponent's hand, bind it face down, and at the end of that turn, your opponent puts that card bound by this effect into his or her hand.
cards.flavor: The strong will not always win. Wait for the right chance, and the weak will claim victory.

cards.text: [ACT](VC/RC):[Counter-Blast 1] This unit gets [Power] +1000 until end of turn.
cards.flavor: It's the end of the darkness…… Stealth Arts, Bloody Rain.

cards.text: [AUTO](RC):[Counter-Blast 1] When this unit boosts([Boost]) a &ltNubatama&gt with [Limit-Break 4], you may pay the cost. If you do, the boosted([Boost]) unit gets [Power] +3000 until end of that battle.
cards.flavor: That is Asvasirsa, the prison guard of Hades.

cards.text:
[AUTO]:Forerunner (When a unit of the same clan rides this unit, you may call this unit to (RC))
[AUTO](RC):[Put this unit into your soul] When an attack hits a vanguard during the battle this unit boosted([Boost]) a <Nubatama> with [Limit-Break 4], you may pay the cost. If you do, draw a card.
cards.flavor: You guys drink up too! What's better than juice after a hard battle!
There is darkness in the depths of the heart. The blade of the Stealth Dragon will destroy that darkness.
Well then, this cage…… do you have the courage to open it?

cards.text: (You may only have up to four cards with "[Heal] HEAL" in a deck.)
cards.flavor: She is the fiend that brings happiness.

cards.text: [ACT](RC):[Put this unit into your soul] Choose up to one of your &ltNubatama&gt, and that unit gets [Power] +3000 until end of turn.
cards.flavor: That pattern, is a demonic painting drawn with souls.

cards.text: [AUTO](RC):When your vanguard's drive check reveals a grade 3 &ltNova Grappler&gt, [Stand] this unit.
cards.flavor: The soldiers who never sleep. They are the platoon of eternity.
The burning fighting spirit, that is the Lion Heart.

cards.text: [AUTO](VC/RC):[Counter-Blast 1]-&ltNova Grappler&gt] When this unit attacks, if you have a &ltNova Grappler&gt vanguard, you may pay the cost. If you do, this unit gets [Power] +4000 until end of that battle.
cards.flavor: The Raizer plays a very active role in the tactics of battle.

cards.text: [AUTO](RC): When this unit attacks, if you have a vanguard with "Beast Deity" in its card name, this unit gets [Power] +3000 until end of that battle.
cards.flavor: The body is full of weapons. Knowing how to use them is most vital for a martial artist.

cards.text:
[AUTO]:Forerunner (When a unit of the same clan rides this unit, you may call this unit to (RC))
[AUTO](RC):During your battle phase, when this unit [Stand], this unit gets [Power] +3000 until end of turn.
cards.flavor: I am the embodiment of the night…… the warrior of Hades!
Ah, but a stab would be sufficient.
Let's go for another round in the ring!
One strike, one kill! …… well, another strike it is then.

cards.text: (You may only have up to four cards with "[Heal] HEAL" in a deck.)
cards.flavor: A real warrior is one who is able give courage to those who see him.

cards.text: [AUTO](VC/RC):When this unit attacks a vanguard, if you have a &ltDimension Police&gt vanguard, and the battle opponent's [Power]  is 8000 or less, until end of that battle, this unit gets "[AUTO](VC/RC):When this unit's attack hits, draw a card.".
cards.flavor: Using strong monsters in the fusion process, will definitely give birth to a stronger monster!

cards.text: [AUTO](VC/RC):When this unit attacks, if you have a &ltDimension Police&gt vanguard or rear-guard with [Limit-Break 4], this unit gets [Power] +3000 until end of that battle.
cards.flavor: Be careful using a two handed whip? I've never been told that before!

cards.text: [AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks, if the battle opponent's [Power]  is 8000 or less, this unit gets [Power] +3000 until end of that battle.
cards.flavor: The concept of Justice, and invaders from the prallel universe…… they are all enemies! There are no differences between them and the likes of monsters.

cards.text: [AUTO](RC):[Counter-Blast 1] When this unit boosts([Boost]) a &ltDimension Police&gt with [Limit-Break 4], you may pay the cost. If you do, the boosted([Boost]) unit gets [Power] +3000 until end of that battle.
cards.flavor: Yes, the speed of light is the limit of speed. …… however, we have a reason to  exceed the limits.

cards.text:

[AUTO](RC):[Put this unit into your soul] When an attack hits a vanguard during the battle this unit boosted([Boost]) a <Dimension Police> with [Limit-Break 4], you may pay the cost. If you do, draw a card.

There seems to be eye contact.
Leave it to me!
Fly!

cards.text: (You may only have up to four cards with "[Heal] HEAL" in a deck.)
cards.flavor: Leave it to me! I'll fix up everything even if they're in shambles!

cards.flavor: That remarkable shine, and exceptional size of that star…… is however too short-lived.

cards.flavor: You are a prisoner. Don't even think that you can decide on your prison term.

cards.text:

cards.text: [AUTO]:When this unit is placed on (RC) from your drop zone, if you have a &ltGranblue&gt vanguard, this unit gets [Power] +3000 until end of turn.
cards.flavor: The breath of the corroded dragon, are the screams and anguish of those suffering in Cocytus.

cards.text:
